talks.title: Measuring heat transport in layered oxides with time-resolved X-ray scattering
talks.abstract: We measure how heat moves across interfaces in layered oxide films using time-resolved X-ray scattering after a short laser pulse.

talks.title: A poster on machine-learned interatomic potentials
talks.abstract: We train interatomic potentials on density functional theory data and test them on phonon spectra.
